summary: Union County, OR lookout on the Wallowa-Whitman NF, 13 mi SSW of La Grande; 1930s with no year, 1940 placement report, abandoned and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Oregon's index lists it as gone; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: July 4, 1940 Record-Courier item, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page: Neal Taylor to be located at Marion Point once a house could be built for him

evidence.supports: 1930s with the year unknown; listed as abandoned
location: 13 miles south-southwest of La Grande

evidence.quote: Neal Taylor will be located at Marion Point as soon as a house can be built for him.

evidence.supports: Oregon index: type unknown, status gone, coordinates 45.09072 -118.21830
township-range 5S-37E-32 on the Forest Lookouts page

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on county, forest and the 'gone' or 'abandoned' fate. The date is the weak point: firelookout.com gives only '1930s: unknown', so no built year is recorded. The 1940 Record-Courier item (quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) says Neal Taylor would be placed at the site once a house was built, but the page does not say whether that happened, so the story states only the plan and no later staffing. Elevation 6,535 ft comes from firelookout.com only. The brief's coordinates (45.09072, -118.2183) match the Oregon index row (-118.21830). No photos, height or access information found. Budget: 1 WebSearch round plus the second round; about 4 page reads.
